notes:
Lead came in via self-serve signup, product = in-app assistant for their B2B SaaS dashboard.
- Team: 6 product/AI engineers, 2 mobile engineers.
- Current infra: GCP us-east1 + europe-west1 for EU users.
- Use-case: contextual chat inside product (multi-turn), primary goal = reduce support tickets and quick triage.
- Key metrics: 1.2k DAU today, pilot expecting 15k conversations/day; peak concurrency estimate ~50-80 qps.
- Latency requirements: startup first-token <= 300ms target for NA, <= 400ms for EU; steady-state streaming per-token gap <= 60ms. Quote from CTO: "Users abandon if first response > 500ms — need very snappy streaming."
- Model preference: open models (small-medium) with quantized variants; willing to test Redwood-verified Mistral/Llama family variants. Fall back routing desired for cost (cheap model for non-latency critical tasks).
- Security: SOC2 required for procurement; SSO/SAML is must for their admin. Also want audit logs for token-level access events.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, looking at monthly spend < $3k for pilot; long-term goal <$20k ARR for scaled pilot.
- Technical asks: websocket/SSE streaming example for mobile SDK, sample prompt caching suggestions, batching knobs are acceptable only if they do not add startup latency.
- POC plan: 3-day hosted API POC using trial key, run synthetic bursts from EU/NA to measure 95th/99th pct startup latency and per-token streaming gap. SE to set up latency harness and share instructions.
- Current blockers: waiting for SOC2 report + pricing clarification on reserved burst and caching credits.
- Quotes from notes: "If Redwood can hit sub-300ms startup most of the time we can go live on 1.0; if not, we need to re-evaluate fallback flows."
- Related artifacts: pricing doc and security readout uploaded to drive. Gmail thread: thread-CA+20260305def contains follow-up pricing Qs. Jira REDW-1342 opened to validate streaming examples and SDK sample for React Native.
